records.text: Late one night Offcer James Saylor of the Crow Police Department ap- proached a truck parked on United States Highway 212, a public right- of-way within the Crow Reservation in the State of Montana. Saylor spoke to the driver, Joshua James Cooley, and observed that Cooley appeared to be non-native and had watery, bloodshot eyes. Saylor also noticed two semiautomatic rifes lying on Cooley's front seat.
